searchText: how so? `INVALID + LVH: null == INVALID_BLOCK_HASH` If `INVALID` in terms of the execution there always need to be a valid parent hash What exactly are you trying to do before getting this error? That's good. I mean EL would behave this way if we had such a combination of requests. What will happen on the CL side if EL returns LVH: null in fcU If that's the only case where null can come then it can never come after including in forkchoice, as I say above it can never come in FCU therefore we never need to prune in this situation which leads me back to my original question of whether all ELs adhere to this and by the time I need to prune anything from forkchoice I'm guaranteed to have an ancestor oh, i see, yes there must be no such situation The problem for EL could be pipelining the LVH up to the engine API, but in the response to the fcU call at least _something_ must be returned Ok I'm getting rid of that code and I'm hoping that it won't break some combinations of Prysm nodes 😂
